extension.note: YUMAng is a synthetic benchmark extension, not a historical Abilene PoP.

fault.root_cause: IS-IS is disabled on the only YUMAng backbone interface, preventing formation/maintenance of the IS-IS adjacency and withdrawal/absence of remote routes.

expected_symptoms: YUMAng no longer has an established IS-IS neighbour with SNVAng.
SNVAng no longer has a stable Up adjacency with YUMAng.
YUMAng loses remote proto isis routes and retains only directly connected networks.
Existing hosts lose reachability to 10.254.0.48/30 and pc_yumang.

recovery.note: Adjacency recovery can precede full routing/forwarding convergence; wait for RIB restoration before declaring recovery complete.
